theme: An open Sunday before the house fills back up.
greeting: The board review with Mike is done and the calendar is clear, Dan — a rare open Sunday. The girls arrive this evening, so the quiet afternoon is yours to spend on the few things that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the CIFIC recruiter
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani at Noorani + Partners is running a VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search for CIFIC and asked to discuss it if it interests you. His note has sat unanswered since Wednesday.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the board's only p1 and was flagged to book back in September. That market thins over the holidays the longer it waits; a refundable hold removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break
needsAttention.detail: The all-kids December trip still needs a shortlist and a call. The board's book-by date was Oct 15, now three days past, and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year.

resolved.title: Brunswick interviews locked in
resolved.detail: Erika Maass confirmed Teams interviews with Jonathan Doorley and Christian for Oct 27 (10:00 and 1:30); the invites are sent.
